card.name: First digit of a split number
card.fires_on: A digit such as 1, 2, 3 or 4 that starts a number whose remaining digits come in the next piece. It appears in dose amounts, ranges, years and measurements, often after a dash, "every" or "to".

modes.label: Dose or interval digit
modes.description: Leading digit of a dose or dosing interval, such as the hours between doses.

modes.label: Range or measurement digit
modes.description: Leading digit of the second number in a range or a size.

modes.label: Year or percent digit
modes.description: Leading digit of a year or a percentage that continues in the next piece.
